text:
maria: Heads-up — we need to lock the MVP cutlist today to hit the May 12 milestone. Capacity is tighter than expected; target is ~20% scope reduction.

alex: Ok. Can you post the candidate cuts? i'd prefer we avoid touching infra SLOs unless absolutely necessary.

priya: Candidate list: prompt-gallery (UX heavy), multi-tenant routing (auth + infra), embeddings-admin UI, autoscale-burst (burst capacity tuning). My take: cut prompt-gallery and embeddings-admin UI; defer multi-tenant routing to v1; keep autoscale-burst but reduce initial capacity.

chris: +1 on deferring multi-tenant routing — it's a big infra lift. prompt-gallery is mostly UX, so that seems safe to drop for MVP. Need to check telemetry hooks that rely on gallery for some metrics.

sam: Quick question — will removing prompt-gallery break any partner pilots? @maria

maria: Checked with PMs: ACME pilot uses prompt-gallery but they've accepted a trimmed flow for the pilot. We can ship with catalog-only for partners and add gallery in v1.

judy: Need to update acceptance criteria and rollout checklist if we cut those. Suggested acceptance floor: P95 gen latency <= 250ms, 99th not > 400ms for targeted routes; token-cost uplift must be < +10% vs baseline. Also QA regression set for hallucination on top-100 prompts.

kevin: I can own canary + rollback plan. Proposed canary config:
```
traffic: 5%
duration: 48h
metrics: [p95_latency, error_rate, token_cost, hallucination_score]
rollback_criteria: error_rate > 1% OR p95_latency increase > 40ms OR hallucination_score degrade > 5pts
```
I'll prepare dashboards and an alert runbook.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: release branch redwood/mvp-cut-2025 created and queued for canary. CI: green.

alex: Final decision from product: cut prompt-gallery and embeddings-admin UI, defer multi-tenant routing to v1, keep autoscale-burst but limit burst to reserved GPUs only for first-week. Update tickets and release notes.

maria: Thanks all. I'll update the roadmap doc and create an ops sync at 11:00 to go over canary. Owners: @kevin canary/rollback, @alex product PR, @priya release notes.

priya: :thumbsup: release notes and cutlist updated in the doc: https://redwood.atlassian/x/ABC-123 — added tracking labels and ticket links.

chris: One more ask: list the runtime config toggles needed for immediate rollback (feature flags, routing fallback). We should be able to flip in <5 minutes.

maria: Noted. I'll attach a toggle list and explicit rollback steps to the release ticket before 11am.

kevin: I'll wire alerting and test the rollback path in staging this afternoon.

maria: Great — meeting at 11. If anyone has blockers before then ping me. :thumbsup:
